locator.text: Equation (9.17), p. 113, in the statement of Lemma 9.8

evidence: paper: |Z_j|_m + |\Delta u_j|_m \le C_{j,m}\, q^{g_j-\ell_m}\,(1+|\log q|)^{P_{j,m}},\qquad g_j = \tfrac{h}{10}\,j \longrightarrow \infty

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Every ingredient matches, with three encoding rewritings. (i) Norms: the paper's |V|_m is the pointwise max over multi-indices |α|+b ≤ m of ∂_x^α ∂_t^b V (definition (5.23), p. 55); Lean bounds max_{k ≤ m} ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ·‖, equivalent up to a dimensional constant absorbed into C. (ii) Tuples: |Z_j|_m + |Δu_j|_m, with Z_j = (A_j, B_j, p_j) (paper p. 114: 'use the representatives Zj = ( A j , Bj , p j )'), becomes the sum of the four norms of potentialStages, directStages, pressureStages and stageVelocity = curl A + B; a sum of four terms lies between the max and 4× the max, so the two bounds differ only by the constant. (iii) Index: Lean states the bound at stage j+1 with exponent gain h (j+1) = h(j+1)/10, i.e. exactly g_i = hi/10 for every i ≥ 1, which is the range the paper uses (p. 114 'For j ≥ 1'); g_0 = 0 is the empty case. ℓ_m = physicalLoss h m carries no stage index, as the paper requires, and includes the one extra derivative for recovering velocities from potentials; C and P are produced under ∀ j m, so they may depend on j and m, matching C_{j,m}, P_{j,m}. 'g_j → ∞' is a separate declaration, gain_tendsto_atTop. The bound holds on physicalSublevel h (commonQ B N0) = preterminal ∩ {physicalQ h w < commonQ B N0} with commonQ ≤ 1, the paper's domain 0 < q < q_0 ≤ 1.
